name: D.T.C. Enterprise Public Company Limited
summary: Established in Bangkok, Thailand, in 1996, D.T.C. Enterprise Public Company Limited is a leading provider of advanced satellite-based tracking solutions and Internet of Things (IoT) technologies. The company engineers and distributes a wide array of products, including real-time GPS trackers designed for various assets like land vehicles, motorcycles, and containers, in addition to black box recording units. D.T.C. Enterprise also delivers sophisticated in-vehicle surveillance systems, such as mobile digital video recorders (DVRs) and smart eye monitoring devices. Their software suite is extensive, featuring applications for transport management, business activity oversight, online mapping, fleet upkeep, and intelligent agricultural systems. The company further specializes in crafting bespoke technological solutions for diverse sectors. This includes excise duty gauge systems, internal office IT infrastructure development, DVR camera setups for emergency services like fire engines and rescue departments, administrative resource management tools, and smart vending machine IoT deployments. They also implement fire detection systems, monitoring for oil handling in border regions, and databases for liquor sales near educational facilities. With a substantial global footprint, D.T.C. Enterprise exports its innovations to numerous countries, including China, the Philippines, Indonesia, India, Laos, Bangladesh, Vietnam, Kenya, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Myanmar, and Cambodia, among other international markets.
